description: This file defines a custom exception class 'PatientIdentifierException' that extends 'APIException'. It is part of the 'org.openmrs.api' package and manages exceptions related to patient identifiers within the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: PatientIdentifierException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to patient identifiers in OpenMRS, extending the generic APIException.

methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty patient identifier exception.
